WITH organizers AS (
    SELECT b.UserId, COUNT(*) AS award_count
    FROM badges AS b
    WHERE b.Name = 'Organizer'
    GROUP BY b.UserId
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM organizers WHERE award_count > 1) AS repeat_organizers,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(loc.Location, ' | ')
     FROM (
         SELECT DISTINCT u.Location
         FROM organizers AS o
         JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = o.UserId
         WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
            OR u.Location LIKE '%Deutschland%'
         ORDER BY u.Location
         LIMIT 60
     ) AS loc) AS sample_locations,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(fmt.pattern, ' | ')
     FROM (
         SELECT DISTINCT TYPEOF(b.Date) || ':' || LENGTH(b.Date) AS pattern
         FROM badges AS b
     ) AS fmt) AS date_formats

arguments.sql:
SELECT u.Location,
       SUM(CASE WHEN b.Date < o.Date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS earlier_badges
FROM badges AS o
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = o.UserId
JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = o.UserId
WHERE o.Name = 'Organizer'
  AND u.Location IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(u.Location) <> ''
GROUP BY o.Id, u.Location
ORDER BY u.Location, earlier_badges

arguments.sql:
WITH organizer_profiles AS (
    SELECT u.Location,
           COUNT(b.Id) AS earlier_badges
    FROM badges AS o
    JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = o.UserId
    LEFT JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = o.UserId AND b.Date < o.Date
    WHERE o.Name = 'Organizer'
      AND u.Location IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(u.Location) <> ''
    GROUP BY o.Id, u.Location
)
SELECT SUBSTR(Location, 1, 1) AS initial,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Location) AS locations,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Location LIKE '%Germany%' AND earlier_badges = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exactly_five,
       SUM(CASE WHEN Location LIKE '%Germany%' AND earlier_badges >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS at_least_five
FROM organizer_profiles
GROUP BY initial
ORDER BY initial

arguments.sql:
WITH organizer_awards AS (
    SELECT o.UserId, MIN(o.Date) AS organizer_date
    FROM badges AS o
    JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = o.UserId
    WHERE o.Name = 'Organizer'
      AND (
          u.Location IN ('Germany', 'Munich', 'Minga')
          OR u.Location LIKE '%, Germany'
      )
    GROUP BY o.UserId
),
qualifying_users AS (
    SELECT o.UserId
    FROM organizer_awards AS o
    JOIN badges AS b
      ON b.UserId = o.UserId
     AND b.Date < o.organizer_date
    GROUP BY o.UserId
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 5
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM qualifying_users
LIMIT 1
